reduction.name: Add reduction clause
reduction.description: Replace shared accumulation with OpenMP reduction clause. This is the most performant fix for simple accumulation patterns (+, -, *, min, max).
reduction.applicable_when: A shared variable uses a compound assignment (+=, *=, etc.) inside a parallel for loop
reduction.performance_impact: Best — each thread accumulates locally, merge at barrier

atomic.name: Add #pragma omp atomic
atomic.description: Protect a single memory update with an atomic operation. Lighter than critical sections but limited to single statements.
atomic.applicable_when: A single shared variable is updated with a simple statement (var++, var += expr, var = var op expr)
atomic.performance_impact: Good — hardware-level atomic, no lock overhead

critical.name: Wrap in #pragma omp critical
critical.description: Protect the access with a named critical section. Works for any code block but serializes all threads entering the same named section.
critical.applicable_when: Complex multi-statement access to shared data, or when atomic/reduction are not applicable
critical.correctness: Guaranteed correct for any code block

private_clause.name: Add private clause
private_clause.description: Declare the variable as private so each thread gets its own copy. Use for temporary/scratch variables that don't need to be shared.
private_clause.applicable_when: A variable is used as scratch space inside the parallel region and its initial/final values don't matter
private_clause.correctness: Correct only if the variable doesn't need cross-thread communication

declare_inside_loop.name: Declare variable inside loop body
declare_inside_loop.description: Move the variable declaration inside the loop body so it becomes automatically private (stack-local to each thread's iteration).
declare_inside_loop.applicable_when: A temporary variable is declared before the loop but only used within the loop body
declare_inside_loop.correctness: Correct when variable is only used within iteration

barrier.name: Add explicit barrier
barrier.description: Insert #pragma omp barrier between phases that produce and consume shared data.
barrier.applicable_when: A parallel region has multiple phases where later phases depend on results from earlier phases
barrier.correctness: Ensures all threads complete phase 1 before any starts phase 2

consistent_lock_order.name: Enforce consistent lock ordering
consistent_lock_order.description: Always acquire multiple locks in the same global order (e.g., by address or by name). This prevents circular wait deadlocks.
consistent_lock_order.applicable_when: Multiple locks are acquired by different threads in different orders
consistent_lock_order.correctness: Prevents deadlock by eliminating circular wait

with_lock.name: Wrap in with lock: (Python)
with_lock.description: Use a context manager to protect shared variable access with a threading.Lock.
with_lock.applicable_when: A shared variable is accessed from multiple Python threads
with_lock.template_python:
_lock = threading.Lock()

def worker():
    with _lock:
        shared_var = new_value
with_lock.correctness: Guaranteed correct for any code block

remove_nowait.name: Remove nowait clause
remove_nowait.description: Remove the nowait clause from a worksharing construct whose results are used by subsequent code.
remove_nowait.applicable_when: A #pragma omp for nowait produces data consumed by subsequent parallel code
remove_nowait.correctness: Ensures all iterations complete before dependent code runs

padding.name: Add cache line padding
padding.description: Pad shared arrays so each thread's data occupies its own cache line, eliminating false sharing.
padding.applicable_when: Performance degradation due to false sharing on adjacent array elements
padding.performance_impact: Significant improvement for false sharing cases
